stage0077_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「What? This doesn't feel very
　'Neo,' does it.」

stage0077_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$アンドレイ$$
「Intel says it's the old Zeon forces
　left on the ground, regrouping.」

stage0077_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「The units are classics, but this is bad...
　These guys...」

stage0077_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$アンドレイ$$
「Watch out, Lieutenant!
　They're firing!」

stage0077_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$アンドレイ$$
「Unbelievable...!
　This much damage from a first strike!」

stage0077_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Watch it, $$アンドレイ$$!
　These guys have no ordinary guts!」

stage0077_04:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Same as the Gundam crowd...!
　This is more than just will to fight!」

stage0077_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$アンドレイ$$
「Against this many of them,
　we're far too undermanned!」

stage0077_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$アンドレイ$$
「Supreme Command expects us alone
　to hold Dakar!?」

stage0077_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Don't worry.
　You know my nickname too, don't you?」

stage0077_04:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$アンドレイ$$
「The Undying $$コーラサワー$$...?」

stage0077_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「That's an old story.
　Now, Undying's retired, call me the
　Lucky $$コーラサワー$$! Believe in that!」

stage0077_04:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Luck worthy of that name has arrived!
　Reinforcements!」

stage0077_04:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$グラハム$$
「Sorry for the delay.
　We'll cover you from here.」

stage0077_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Been waiting for you, $$グラハム$$ Aker!」

stage0077_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「And our precious reinforcements...!」

stage0077_04:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$グラハム$$
「$$フォウ$$!
　Keep moving, throw off their aim!
　Stand still and you're a target!」

stage0077_04:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$アンドレイ$$
「In the end, only four units left...!」

stage0077_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Guess it's down to quality over
　quantity now!」

stage0077_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$グラハム$$
「Don't let your guard down.
　The main force, sniper included, must
　still be behind them.」

stage0077_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$フォウ$$
「Such strong anger...
　I can feel someone who isn't here...」

stage0077_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$アンドレイ$$
「So there really are reinforcements...!」

stage0077_04:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「I'll worry about that when it happens!
　First we deal with the guys
　in front of us! No way around it!」

stage0077_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$グラハム$$
「Heh... I should learn from that
　positivity of yours.」

stage0077_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$グラハム$$
「All units, follow me!
　If they've got resolve, so do we!
　Let's show them our pride!」

stage0077_04:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$カガリ$$
「Secretary $$リリーナ$$, Commander $$レディ・アン$$...
　They... $c will surely come.
　Let's believe in that.」

stage0077_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$マリナ$$
（$$刹那$$...
　Are you somewhere near here too...）

stage0077_04:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$アンドレイ$$
「Seems like we managed somehow.」

stage0077_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Don't let your guard down!
　Here comes the next one!」

stage0077_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Damn it!
　Looks like more reinforcements
　have come!」

stage0077_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「And what the hell is that
　huge thing on top of it!?」

stage0077_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$グラハム$$
「An amphibious Mobile Armor!
　Its target is the parliament building!」

stage0077_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$アンドレイ$$
「$$大統領$$ and the rest of the moderates
　are all gathered there!
　If anything happens to them...!」

stage0077_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$グラハム$$
「The war between Earth and the colonies
　will turn into a quagmire!」

stage0077_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$ロニ$$
「I've been waiting for this moment...!
　Father, Mother... I'll avenge your
　grief myself!」

stage0077_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$カークス$$
「$$ロニ$$, our objective is to hold
　Dakar, nothing more.
　You head for the parliament building.」

stage0077_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「That huge thing, its target really
　is the parliament building!」

stage0077_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$アンドレイ$$
「At this difference in strength,
　we'll be pushed back!」

stage0077_04:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$グラハム$$
「It's too soon to give up!」

stage0077_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「This is $c.
　We've gone ahead of the main force
　to cover you.」

stage0077_04:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$グラハム$$
「I've been waiting,
　my friend, $$プリベンター$$ Wind.」

stage0077_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「You're here too, $$プリベンター$$ Lightning.」

stage0077_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$グラハム$$
「Orders from Commander $$レディ・アン$$.
　Though the forces she could spare
　were limited.」

stage0077_04:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「The world's hope lies in that
　parliament building.
　We can't afford to lose it.」

stage0077_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「Heh... I understand your worry for
　$$リリーナ$$, but going on ahead alone
　is far too reckless, $$ヒイロ$$.」

stage0077_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「That's rich, coming from someone
　thinking the same thing.」

stage0077_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「$$ゼロ$$ asked me to.
　He must be worried for his sister too.」

stage0077_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$ゼクス$$
（Something's off about $$ヒイロ$$...
　Is there something going on?）

stage0077_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$グラハム$$
「The enemy's morale is higher than
　ever before...!
　We'll answer with formation tactics!」

stage0077_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$グラハム$$
「It's been a while since we
　teamed up.」

stage0077_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「A former $$ブリタニア・ユニオン$$ top gun
　and a former AEU ace, together...!
　Let's show them a thing or two!」

stage0077_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$アンドレイ$$
「Then, Ensign $$フォウ$$ is with me.」

stage0077_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$フォウ$$
「Glad to be working with you,
　Lieutenant $$アンドレイ$$.」

stage0077_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$グラハム$$
「Our job is to pin down that
　giant Mobile Armor!
　Let's go!」

stage0077_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「The Colonel... no, the Brig. Gen.
　must've seen this coming when he
　sent me. I'll live up to that!」

stage0077_04:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$ロニ$$
「Federation scum!
　Resist us in vain, and you'll only
　shed more blood!!」

stage0077_04:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$フォウ$$
「That girl...!
　She's dominated by a Psycommu...!?」

stage0077_04:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$大統領$$
「At this rate, even here will...」

stage0077_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$アドヴェント$$
「Rest assured, $$大統領$$.
　They've arrived.」

stage0077_04:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$グラハム$$
「Major $$グラハム$$ Aker.
　I go by the name $$プリベンター$$
　Lightning now.」

stage0077_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$レディ・アン$$ sent us a reliable man.」

stage0077_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「That's right, Celestial Being!
　Well... we're in a bit of a
　tight spot!」

stage0077_04:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$フォウ$$, is that you!?
　Weren't you supposed to be a
　test pilot...」

stage0077_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$フォウ$$
「I wanted to be of help to you
　and the others, so I accepted
　Commander $$レディ・アン$$'s offer.」

stage0077_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$グラハム$$
「Ensign $$フォウ$$ and I have been
　fighting as backup members
　for $c.」

stage0077_04:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$フォウ$$
「On the Commander's orders, I'm
　joining the unit from today.
　Nice to meet you.」

stage0077_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$シン$$
「$$カミーユ$$!
　This isn't the time to celebrate
　your reunion with $$フォウ$$!」

stage0077_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「I know!
　We have to stop that Mobile
　Armor!」

stage0077_04:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Careful.
　That thing binds the human mind.」

stage0077_04:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$刹那$$
「So that unit is what's spreading
　this hatred around...!」

stage0077_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$アンドレイ$$
「An ultra-long range sniper unit...!
　That's the commander's machine!」

stage0077_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$カークス$$
「Calm down, $$ロニ$$.
　Don't cause needless casualties.」

stage0077_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$ロニ$$
「Major!
　Have you forgotten what the
　Federation did to us!」

stage0077_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$カークス$$
（The Psycommu, running wild...
　Is it the memory of Father and Mother,
　taken by the Federation, demanding blood...!?）

stage0077_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$テッサ$$ will take the underwater
　reinforcements! We'll defend
　the parliament building!」

stage0077_04:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Target the commander's sniper-spec
　Zaku and the giant Mobile Armor!」

stage0077_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$刹那$$
（So $$マリナ・イスマイール$$ is over
　there too...）

stage0077_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
（Rest assured, $$リリーナ$$.
　I'll eliminate every last enemy.）

stage0077_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$キラ$$
（$$カガリ$$... we'll do our best too.）

stage0077_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$ゼロ$$
（$$ナナリー$$...!
　We'll protect you, as you try
　to protect the world!）

stage0077_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$カークス$$
「You think I'd die and leave $$ロニ$$
　behind!!」

stage0077_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$デュオ$$
「That guy's still got fight left
　in him!?」

stage0077_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$カトル$$
「He's fighting somewhere beyond
　life and death!」

stage0077_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$アムロ$$
（This feeling... same as it was
　at Solomon...）

stage0077_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$アムロ$$
（At the bottom of the gravity well...
　do people never change...!）

stage0077_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$ロニ$$
「Federation scum!
　You took Father and Mother's lives,
　now you're after mine too...!」

stage0077_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「I know!
　At this rate they'll be completely
　swallowed by the Psycommu!」

stage0077_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$アムロ$$
（The same thing, over and over again...!）

stage0077_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$アムロ$$
（At the bottom of the gravity well...
　do people never change...!）

stage0077_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「That big brute!
　It won't stop that easily!」

stage0077_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$アレルヤ$$
「What's driving that pilot to fight like that!?」

stage0077_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$ロニ$$
「Damn the Federation!
　If you're going to stand in my way!」

stage0077_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「I know!
　At this rate they'll be completely
　swallowed by the Psycommu!」

stage0077_04:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$アムロ$$
（The same thing, over and over again...!）

stage0077_04:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$アムロ$$
（At the bottom of the gravity well...
　do people never change...!）

stage0077_04:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$ロニ$$
「Split-Horn!?
　Not yet, $$ガランシェール$$!」

stage0077_04:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$カークス$$
「Is that boy going to get in our way!?」

stage0077_04:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$ロニ$$
「Are you saying that boy betrayed us...!?」

stage0077_04:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$バナージ$$
「If you want the box's seal broken,
　I'll do it! So please, stop this!」

stage0077_04:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$ロニ$$
「Why is the key to the box
　getting in our way!?」

stage0077_04:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$カークス$$
「If that boy really means to break
　the box's seal, then fine. But if he
　joins the Federation, we start over.」

stage0077_04:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$ロニ$$
「We've taken the long way around,
　this whole time...! If we lose this chance!」

stage0077_04:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$!
　Where's $$オードリー$$...!?」

stage0077_04:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$リディ$$
「Is this the time to be saying that?
　Think...!」

stage0077_04:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$ロニ$$
「Don't get in my way, $$バナージ$$!
　Get out of the way!!」

stage0077_04:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$スメラギ$$
「That mobile armor's pilot,
　is she someone $$バナージ$$ knows!?」

stage0077_04:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$オットー$$
「It's our chance!
　While it's distracted by $$バナージ$$!」

stage0077_04:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Alright!
　I'll blow that cockpit wide open...!」

stage0077_04:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Provoking that pilot is dangerous!
　For now, let's trust in $$バナージ$$!」

stage0077_04:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Why are you doing this!?」

stage0077_04:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$ロニ$$
「Because that's what I've lived for!
　I'll settle this old grudge here!」

stage0077_04:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$ロニ$$
「It's too late now!
　If you stop me, everything really
　will have been for nothing!」

stage0077_04:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$ロニ$$
「Get out of my way, $$バナージ$$!
　And hurry up and become a Split-Horn!」

stage0077_04:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$バナージ$$
「No! The people hurt here,
　and their families, will only grow
　to hate you even more!」

stage0077_04:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$リディ$$
「It's no use, $$バナージ$$!
　That Zeon's consumed by resentment!」

stage0077_04:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Stop it, $$ロニ$$!
　If you keep doing this, your heart
　will break, and you won't be human!」

stage0077_04:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$ロニ$$
「Shut up! My father and mother
　both died in the Zeon remnant purges!
　Denied even prison, just killed!」

stage0077_04:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$ロニ$$
「I live to carry on my father's will!
　The box doesn't even need to open!
　This grudge won't clear that easily!」

stage0077_04:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$リディ$$
「Give it up, $$バナージ$$! Nothing you
　say to that pilot will do any good!
　We have no choice but to destroy it!」

stage0077_04:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Force won't solve anything!
　She's only trapped, this isn't
　her true heart! I'll stop her!」

stage0077_04:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$リディ$$
（That's right, she's trapped,
　by a curse of blood that will
　never be broken...!）

stage0077_04:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Listen to me, $$ロニ$$! Is this
　really what you want? Is the real
　you okay with this, $$ロニ$$!!」

stage0077_04:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$ロニ$$
「Because for me... there's nothing
　left but this... no other reason
　to live...」

stage0077_04:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Find one. It's too sad if hatred
　and anger are all you live for...」

stage0077_04:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$ロニ$$
「Being angry at injustice is human!
　People aren't gods!」

stage0077_04:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Even so!
　I have to stop you!」

stage0077_04:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$刹那$$
「$$バナージ$$ and that pilot...
　did they understand each other!?」

stage0077_04:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$カークス$$
「$$シャンブロ$$'s already at its limit.」

stage0077_04:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$カークス$$
「But I won't hand $$ロニ$$ over...!
　Even if I have to rip out the cockpit...!」

stage0077_04:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$カークス$$
「$$ロニ$$...! You...!
　Don't you become...
　like us...!!」

stage0077_04:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$ロニ$$
「You got $$カークス$$...!
　The Federation's taken again!
　The one who protected me, my last family!!」

stage0077_04:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$ロニ$$
「My place to belong... is only
　here now...!!」

stage0077_04:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Has she been consumed by the Psycommu!?」

stage0077_04:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$バナージ$$
「$$ロニ$$...!
　Get a hold of yourself, $$ロニ$$!!

stage0077_04:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$リディ$$
「What are you doing, $$バナージ$$!
　Fight!!」

stage0077_04:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$リディ$$
「That 'potential' will get you
　killed!! Throw it away!!」

stage0077_04:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$アムロ$$
「If you won't stop her or save her,
　then get out of here!!」

stage0077_04:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$アムロ$$
「She's consumed by that machine
　and its grudge! Same as you,
　controlled by the NT-D!!」

stage0077_04:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「$$バナージ$$! Stop her!
　That's your fight!!」

stage0077_04:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「$$バナージ・リンクス$$.
　Will you submit to fate?」

stage0077_04:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「It's you who changes the future.
　If you give up, that's submitting to fate.」

stage0077_04:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$ゼクス$$
（$$ヒイロ$$...
　Did you see something with the Wing Zero...?）

stage0077_04:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「If you believe in possibility,
　then change the future. With your Gundam.」

stage0077_04:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Does that Gundam exist to kill people?」

stage0077_04:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$バナージ$$
「That's right... I want to fight
　not to kill, but to save...」

stage0077_04:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$刹那$$
「$$バナージ$$! You and she
　should have understood each other!」

stage0077_04:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$n
「Take responsibility yourself!
　We've got your back!!」

stage0077_04:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Your machine... the Unicorn
　should have the power for that!!」

stage0077_04:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I...!
　I want to stop her...!
　I have to stop her!」

stage0077_04:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Gundam!
　Lend me your strength!!」

stage0077_04:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
（All that's left now is to give it
　everything I've got...）

stage0077_04:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$!
　Back up $$バナージ$$!」

stage0077_04:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$リディ$$!
　Don't lose yourself!!」

stage0077_04:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$リディ$$
「Let's do this!
　It's the only way to protect the city!」

stage0077_04:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Stop that giant mobile armor!
　Contain it, and the fight is ours!!」

stage0077_04:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$バナージ$$! If you don't
　want to kill her, settle this
　with your own hands!!」

stage0077_04:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$バナージ$$
「$$ロニ$$! You...
　I'll stop your hatred myself!!」

stage0077_04:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$ロニ$$
「Sieg Zeon... Sieg Zeon... Sieg Zeon...」

stage0077_04:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$ロニ$$
「Sieg Zeon... Sieg Zeon... Sieg Zeon...」

stage0077_04:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$カークス$$
（$$ロニ$$... our war is...
　over now...）

stage0077_04:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$ロニ$$
「$$バナージ$$... It's sad,
　isn't it...」

stage0077_04:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$レイアム$$
「The giant mobile armor's stopped moving」

stage0077_04:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$ミヒロ$$
「The other Zeon soldiers are also signaling surrender」

stage0077_04:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$刹那$$
（This spreading sorrow...
　Has it left a wound in everyone's heart...）

stage0077_04:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$アムロ$$
（But, $$バナージ$$...
　your cry was what stopped it）

stage0077_04:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$バナージ$$
「This was for the best, wasn't it,
　$$ジンネマン$$...」

stage0077_04:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$$ニア$$
「After all, I must give you despair」

stage0077_04:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$ニア$$! That form...
　You've become the messenger again!」

stage0077_04:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$ニア$$
「I was, from the very start, born as
　a terminal of the $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$...
　A virtual life form, so to speak...」

stage0077_04:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$ニア$$
「I'm only someone who woke from
　sleep, now that the time has come」

stage0077_04:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$シン$$
「So that's your real form, huh!」

stage0077_04:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$ニア$$
「I declare despair to you once more」

stage0077_04:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$ニア$$
「The $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$ will
　annihilate Earth's humanity」

stage0077_04:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$n
「That's the $$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$'s messenger
　that tried to wipe out humanity
　during the $$再世戦争$$...」

stage0077_04:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$アムロ$$
「$$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$...
　That which denies every possibility,
　is it coming again...」

stage0077_04:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$ロニ$$
「Sieg Zeon... Sieg Zeon... Sieg Zeon...」

stage0077_04:r_b01db8213417811e.text:

「Sieg Zeon... Sieg Zeon... Sieg Zeon...」

stage0077_04:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$ロニ$$
「$$バナージ$$... It's sad,
　isn't it...」

stage0077_04:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$レイアム$$
「The giant mobile armor's been destroyed」

stage0077_04:r_2e59226caa35f6e5.text:
$$オットー$$
「...At any rate, it's over...」

stage0077_04:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$ミヒロ$$
「The other Zeon soldiers are also signaling surrender」

stage0077_04:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Was this... the only ending
　there could be...」

stage0077_04:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$アムロ$$
「So what hasn't changed... is us too...」

stage0077_04:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
（The future couldn't be changed...
　$$ゼロ$$... is this humanity's limit...）

stage0077_04:r_df899b8031b4ca06.text:
$$ニア$$
「After all, I must give you despair」

stage0077_04:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:

stage0077_04:r_432a29155221625f.text:

「So that's your real form, huh!」

「$$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$...
　That which denies every possibility,
　is it coming again...」

stage0077_04:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$$ゼクス$$
「Now the world heads toward...
　an endless quagmire of war...」

stage0077_04:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$アムロ$$
（A machine I'd only seen in a catalog...
　To think it actually existed...）

stage0077_04:r_da648116badd491a.text:
$$アムロ$$
（A valuable machine. I took out its
　power unit, so I hope we can
　recover it later）

stage0077_04:r_4e91ccecf1dd0f66.text:
$$グラハム$$
「I've already thrown away my past...!
　All that remains here is myself!」

stage0077_04:r_ef339c6f71e7560f.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Wait for me, Colonel... no,
　Brigadier General! I'll wrap this
　up fast and be right back!」

stage0077_04:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$$コーラサワー$$
「And then praise me like always!
　Say, 'You never change'!」

stage0077_04:r_13ce8d4e4858b193.text:
$$アンドレイ$$
（A soldier's duty is to protect
　the people's freedom and peace...!）

stage0077_04:r_075101b23517fbaa.text:
$$アンドレイ$$
（Father, Mother...! I'll fulfill
　my duty as a soldier!）

stage0077_04:r_13c2ae299018c9ee.text:
$$フォウ$$
「What I can do for the world...!
　It's to fight...!」

stage0077_04:r_6f4f8dd80820f5e7.text:
$$フォウ$$
「I'll do what I can too...!
　With the life $$カミーユ$$ saved!」

stage0077_04:r_afa513b4815df4c9.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Her mind's already at its limit...!
　At this rate she'll be totally
　consumed by the Psycommu!」

stage0077_04:r_6cf1e5ed68d98bd4.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Hurry, $$バナージ$$! With the
　Unicorn, you should be able to
　sync with her consciousness!」

stage0077_04:r_e62eb587b8d34cb9.text:
$$ロニ$$
「Get out of my way! You'll learn,
　you'll learn, you'll leeearn!!」

stage0077_04:r_d72cc2c0739c9088.text:
$$バナージ$$
「This stagnant, black feeling!
　There's no meaning in being dyed
　by something like this!」

stage0077_04:r_ecf4e1c8c0f8d2d7.text:
$$ロニ$$
「Shut up! The Federation is
　Zeon's... my enemy!」

stage0077_04:r_e5a692ea5ce09cac.text:
$$バナージ$$
「Don't let it swallow you, $$ロニ$$!」

stage0077_04:r_e793fc3ce3a0c28d.text:
$$ロニ$$
「It's the world's law that a child
　is swallowed by their parent's
　wish! I'm not wrong!」

stage0077_04:r_2be6c657d0e12c4b.text:
$$バナージ$$
「That's not a wish, it's a curse!」

stage0077_04:r_f89f6c6c4b076e16.text:
$$ロニ$$
「It's the same! To carry out what's
　entrusted to you... that's the
　blood-duty of a parent's child!」

stage0077_04:r_b43bdba9393d4d68.text:
$$ロニ$$
「This is! This is my war!!」

stage0077_04:r_3ec159d1a3492877.text:
$$アムロ$$
「A chain of hatred... a tragedy
　repeated endlessly...! Do you
　understand that, $$シャア$$!」

stage0077_04:r_4e2fbafa9ebef558.text:
$$アムロ$$
「If we keep doing this, it's people,
　more than the Earth, who won't
　hold out!」

stage0077_04:r_bde2e27bac7e3317.text:
$$シン$$
「Hating and being hated, paying
　it back with war! I'm sick of
　all that!」

stage0077_04:r_631834aa1545ba7b.text:
$$シン$$
「Just stop already! A fight
　that's nothing but spitting out
　hatred is just sad!!」

stage0077_04:r_0cd6aab432ee5af7.text:
$$キラ$$
「You must have felt so much
　sorrow...」

stage0077_04:r_c8b75f3bca245a85.text:
$$キラ$$
「But something like this can't
　be forgiven!」

stage0077_04:r_b26be73e3c0c8bed.text:
$$キラ$$
「We'll take on that hatred! So
　we're the ones who'll stop you!!」

stage0077_04:r_1a4dc288e81719ee.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
（Sorrow, hatred, and war...
　An endless waltz...）

stage0077_04:r_b8902c992035da79.text:
$$ヒイロ$$
（Cut that root away, $$リリーナ$$...）

stage0077_04:r_df10ad0a71c307da.text:
$$刹那$$
（We should understand each other,
　yet we refuse to... That's how
　the world fills with war...）

stage0077_04:r_9293c52555ba1457.text:
$$刹那$$
（I... where is our fight heading...）

stage0077_04:r_6c41647935e2574a.text:
$$宗介$$
「I am a soldier. I will promptly
　carry out the mission I'm given」

stage0077_04:r_51ce1d8caa34c103.text:
$$ゼロ$$
（I can imagine how much sorrow
　you've been living in...!）

stage0077_04:r_d00313056b19262c.text:
$$ゼロ$$
（But I will stop you! To protect
　the world... and $$ナナリー$$, above
　all!）

stage0077_04:r_2c37dd5b8f919a88.text:
$$フォウ$$
「But I won't let this sorrow
　spread any further! So I'll be
　the one to stop you!」

stage0077_04:r_53f5199f05a9aad8.text:
$$フォウ$$
「Just like $$カミーユ$$ and the others
　stopped me!」

stage0077_04:r_07513334490fbdf9.text:
$$キリコ$$
（But there's no meaning in hating
　the world... What's lost won't
　come back, no matter what you do）

stage0077_04:r_d90c4affdd742a0e.text:
$n
「Even if we fight... a fight
　like this...」

stage0077_04:r_fa09fad95980b867.text:
$n
「I know...! That what we really
　have to fight isn't her, but
　her hatred, I know that much...!」

stage0077_04:r_3c9956c9d519d2a2.text:
$$カークス$$
「Celestial Being's green Gundam...!
　A sniping model!」

stage0077_04:r_d150caab246bbd7a.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「These days I'm more spray than snipe,
　but your marksmanship got my blood
　racing for the first time in a while!」

stage0077_04:r_d23d30b65284f69d.text:
$$ロックオン$$
「Slipping past your aim, I'm
　the one who's gonna take you
　down!」

stage0077_04:r_b2f67d46499f2bbd.text:
$$クルツ$$
「The world's a big place! To think
　a sniper on that guy's level was
　smoldering away in Zeon!」

stage0077_04:r_fc1b13eaa4071b9a.text:
$$カークス$$
「A battle between snipers...!
　It'll be decided in an instant!」

stage0077_04:r_c4cdd41ba9207e9c.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Sorry, but I'm the world's greatest
　sniper! I respect your skill, but
　you'll settle for number two!」

stage0077_04:r_11f13ec5326eaa51.text:
$$ロニ$$
（What is this feeling...
　The anger and hatred inside
　me are fading away...）

stage0077_04:r_b69df689192adfc2.text:
$$ロニ$$
（But I...! I can't go back
　anymore!）
